conditioning.note: Implemented in scripts/hydrology.py. richdem and hydrotools are the standard open-source tools for this; both were installed and neither is usable on this host because richdem needs GDAL headers to build.

warning: Real elevation and real ESA WorldCover land cover. The surface is Priority-Flood conditioned and D8 flow accumulation is computed and reported, but the runoff VOLUME is still allocated by solving for a water level rather than routed downhill cell by cell. It is a screening view, not a flood prediction.

assumptions.curveNumberSource: USDA NRCS TR-55; awaiting independent verification
assumptions.doubleCountingRule: Land cover sets the generation term; explicit storage sets the retention term. Open water generates nothing so a pond is never counted in both (ADR-015).

render.note: Depth beyond maxVisibleDepthM is visually saturated, not capped in the data.

landClassProvenance: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021), CC BY 4.0; see data/landcover_hsk.json
